scope: Isolated Edge; generated fixtures and optional saved public Ovid HTML; synthetic API, no user settings or real AI calls. Delayed-header test waits 36 seconds. Screenshots show simulated answers.

results.name: Capture chooses substantive article, preserves inline prose, citations and tables, and inventories lazy figures without duplicates
Research opens as an independent popup; source tables and unread attachments are visible
Overview inventories remote figures without loading originals or AI; filters and selection work without opening details
One click loads all originals without selection; one permission request, failed originals can be selected and retried
Bulk selection, next groups and detail checkboxes stay synchronized; oversized Q&A sends no request
Overview fits narrow and wide windows and remains collapsible
Combined Chat Completions request contains two original images, matching captions and full paper material
Results render headings, comparison tables and code safely; narrow and wide layouts do not overflow
Follow-up carries completed local history; export retains questions and selected figure labels
Invalid oversized selection preserves completed answer and conversation; filtered bulk analysis sends only selected figures in sequence
Stopping a selected batch cancels the active image and does not start remaining images
Responses protocol sends each selected original as an input_image and renders the result
Analysis waits beyond 30 seconds before response headers despite the 10-second translation timeout
Provider stream errors preserve partial answers and exclude them from follow-up context
Premature EOF and HTTP model errors surface actionable messages instead of successful completion
Stopping an analysis aborts its HTTP request and leaves partial output exportable
Bounded history and image validation reject excessive or malformed data before network calls
New papers with main/itemprop/plain-body markup preserve lazy figures and distinct panels sharing one caption
Tables outside the article, wrapped ARIA cells, captions, notes and duplicate panels produce independent readable cards
Long paper capture and analysis preserve the final paragraph beyond former 60k and 140k limits
Navigating to a later paper creates fresh source material and figures without mixing the existing companion
Analysis options collapse by default; settings sections fold, persist, and open from navigation
Configuration changes discard in-flight image loads; retry and removal keep the overview selection consistent
No uncaught Edge page errors
